description: Get an existing published AI summary of collected reviews, with pros and cons. Use extension_reviews for original comments. Returns null when unavailable and English when a translation is missing; never calls a model or generates a new summary.

eid.description: 32-letter Chrome Web Store extension ID (a-p), not a URL, name or slug. Example: cjpalhdlnbpafiamejdnhcphjbkeiagm.

locale.description: Preferred response content language, not a review-language filter or a store search market.

name: extension_review_summary
